concerns.text: The plan lists a *Primary Yield‑Strength Dataset* – *Curated HEA yield‑strength dataset (‑020‑00374‑5)* – **No verified open URL**. This dataset is not publicly downloadable, violating Constitution FR‑030 (all inputs must be open‑source) and FR‑001 (must download a curated dataset). Relying on a non‑reachable dataset makes the pipeline infeasible on CI runners; the fallback OpenML dataset should be adopted as the primary source.
